problem_statement:
Abbreviation and inline math rendering broken

#### Description

The abbreviation plugin is rendering abbreviations incorrectly, swapping the text and title attributes. Additionally, inline math expressions are being reversed.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
import mistune
from mistune.plugins import abbr, math

# Test abbreviation rendering
md = mistune.create_markdown(plugins=['abbr'])
text = """
*[HTML]: HyperText Markup Language

This is HTML abbreviation.
"""
result = md(text)
print("Abbreviation result:", result)
# Expected: <abbr title="HyperText Markup Language">HTML</abbr>
# Actual: Wrong title/text placement

# Test inline math rendering  
md_math = mistune.create_markdown(plugins=['math'])
math_text = "This is inline math: $x^2 + y^2 = z^2$"
math_result = md_math(math_text)
print("Math result:", math_result)
# Expected: Normal math expression
# Actual: Reversed math expression
```

The abbreviation plugin appears to be mixing up the text content and title attribute, while the math plugin is reversing the mathematical expressions.
